data.source_text_main_point: Startup Joost is advancing the Internet TV model by securing content deals with major studios and leveraging peer-to-peer technology to offer free, on-demand programming, aiming to balance consumer flexibility with industry control despite challenges regarding content quality and bandwidth efficiency.

statements.key_statement: Users can customize their online TV experience by interacting with programming via optional widgets.
statements.long_statement: Viewers of the online television service can enhance their experience by interacting with the programming through integrated widgets such as clocks, instant messaging, news feeds, and chat rooms, which can be customized or disabled by the user during viewing sessions.

statements.key_statement: Broadband peer-to-peer connectivity represents a permanent shift in how media is distributed, even though it faced initial difficulties.
statements.long_statement: Despite initial legal challenges and a difficult early adoption phase, online broadband peer-to-peer connectivity represents a permanent shift in media distribution that will remain the standard for delivering content to consumers with high-speed internet access.
